memory_candidates.content: check-extension-docs.sh enforces a 60-line Rule U limit per EXTENSION.md. A content-preserving rewording of even one sentence can silently push the file over the limit; always re-run `bash .claude/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh` (or the scoped `verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 3,26`) immediately after editing an EXTENSION.md, before redeploying, rather than assuming a same-paragraph edit is line-count-neutral.

When a plan's final phase declares Verification Tier: full under a dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, `verify-deploy.sh --only-gate N1,N2 --skip-slow` (naming the specific gates that cover the phase's own touched-file class, e.g. gate3 doc-lint + gate26 extension-README-table-lint for an EXTENSION.md edit) is the correct scoped discharge -- it is both fast and directly traceable to the files actually touched, unlike re-running the whole 43-gate battery or skipping verification entirely.
